decisions.reason: As a recently launched component tied to the firm's existing radiant-heating business, management is likely to continue it because even modest website commitment and sunk development effort make early underperformance easy to treat as temporary.

Because the electric infrared panel heater received its own product page and supports a visible move into electric heating, management would be inclined to persist and justify the launch rather than withdraw it after only about a year.

Although this electric halogen infrared heater may be a more niche offering, its dedicated web presence and the recency of the launch make managers likely to attribute any weak uptake to a slow market ramp-up and keep it for now.

An industrial electric infrared hall heater appears close to the firm's core commercial heating market and was publicly presented on its own page, so escalation of commitment strongly favors continuation.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater has an especially visible public commitment through the named product series and cited real-world deployment, making management very unlikely to retreat from it within the next year.
